The actions described in the paragraph do not appear to violate the specific legal standard mentioned, which is that employees were already working the maximum hours permitted by local labor laws. Since the store extended hours without increasing pay, but the employees were already at their legal limit, the primary legal constraint cited (maximum hours) was not exceeded. However, extending hours beyond a normal schedule, even if within the absolute legal maximum, might raise issues regarding overtime pay depending on how "maximum hours" is defined in the specific jurisdiction (e.g., daily vs. weekly limits). But based strictly on the text stating they were at the "maximum hours permitted," no explicit violation of that specific law is described.
